scientific_integrity: The model-specific fixed-point localization is proved from the published normal form and a local equivariant A-type resolution calculation. The general eight-point theorem is treated as prior work, not as proof of the localization.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero; general canonical irreducible biquadratic double-sextic models of Picard rank greater than 10; excludes the reducible-sextic lattice singled out in the result and does not compute a global projective equation for the quotient.
title: Eight fixed points in the canonical biquadratic double-sextic model
